candidateAudit.title: Eight new places to eat and drink in Vienna, all opened this fall. Three of them are about steak, and one doubles as a small gallery → Zur Alten Liebe ( zuraltenliebe ), French bis
candidateAudit.text: Eight new places to eat and drink in Vienna, all opened this fall. Three of them are about steak, and one doubles as a small gallery → Zur Alten Liebe ( zuraltenliebe ), French bistro food in the old Funkhaus foyer: chicken fricassée, beef tartare. Open since November 4. Argentinierstraße 30A, 1040. Nuje ( nuje.wien ), trattoria meets Beisl by Gaetano Brancato of Il Rione, with ravioli filled with goulash and lunch from €11.90. Open since October 22. Märzstraße 138, 1140. Café Ziege ( cafe_ziege ) sits in a former antiques shop, from the founder of a Naschmarkt coffee bike: own roast, fresh orange juice, homemade cake. Lerchenfelder Straße 108, 1080. LEO am Platz ( leo.am.platz ) took over the old Leopold: brunch by day, comfort food by Martin Löw at night, with murals and light art on the walls. Open since October 15. Große Pfarrgasse 11, 1020. Inigo Asador ( inigoasador.vienna ) cooks Basque-style: large aged cuts over open fire, shared at the table. Johannesgasse 23, 1010 🔥 Mama & der Bulle ( mamaundderbulle ) opened its second location on November 13 in the former Santos: flat iron for €19.90, and a free Brickerl from the ice cream machine 🍦 Siebensterngasse 14, 1070. Māketo ( maketo.vienna ), café, kitchen and Asian grocery from the Liu family, with six living trees and benches made from Vienna’s felled city trees. Open since November 3. Währinger Straße 126, 1180. SOHL ( sohl.restaurant ) replaced the Gasthaus Artner: flat iron from €19, Chateaubriand flambéed with bourbon at the table. Open since November 5. Floragasse 6, 1040.
